handoffs.label: Private libcap correction returned -> bounded runtime-validation direction
handoffs.limit: Includes x86 cleanup and recovery implementation; not pure human idle, and not time to add to overlapping x86 work.

handoffs.label: HOME failure report -> HOME-only authorization
handoffs.limit: Includes coordinator review and other work; first failure preserved. No pure human-think-time measurement.

handoffs.label: Timing-probe result -> optimized-helper direction
handoffs.limit: No local build interval is recorded within this boundary; remote diagnosis/queue/other work not separated.

handoffs.label: v2 readiness -> corrected v3 preparation direction
handoffs.limit: Includes x86 worker-HUD failure and regression checks, not 55 minutes of ARM compilation.

handoffs.label: Legacy REPORT ONLY delivered -> explicit recovery direction
handoffs.limit: Includes local read-only diagnosis; overlap with the next recovery episode must not be summed.

handoffs.label: One-ULP validator refusal reported -> repaired tooling direction
handoffs.limit: Root implementation, testing and delivery overlap; not pure waiting.

handoffs.label: c071 readiness -> first reviewed launch direction
handoffs.limit: Only 157 seconds; new SSH login afterwards invalidated the baseline.

handoffs.label: New SSH baseline blocker report -> exact conditional fresh-attempt direction
handoffs.limit: Positive identity proof was required; no license to waive arbitrary new identities.

handoffs.label: v5 native verification first returned -> package accepted / compat direction
handoffs.limit: Includes archive transfer and root acceptance; network time versus review time is not independently measured.

handoffs.label: Compat launch reported -> stale progress message received
handoffs.limit: 0.512s local receive boundary; message contents reflect an older remote snapshot, not missing authorization.
